specs.title: CF-POM-001: Given duplicate outer fields, When filling wrapped and native fields, Then only the scoped fields change
CF-POM-002: Given two portalled lists, When selecting a quick filter, Then only its associated option is selected
CF-POM-003: Given an unassociated popup, When selecting an option, Then selection requires an explicit popup scope
CF-POM-004: Given disabled or ambiguous controls, When clicking, Then no matching handler executes
CF-POM-005: Given pinned row fragments, When selecting and reading a cashflow, Then stable row and column keys identify the controls
CF-POM-006: Given special identifier characters, When locating a cashflow cell, Then CSS characters remain literal
CF-POM-007: Given repeated query editors, When editing one explicit rule, Then adjacent rule values remain unchanged
CF-POM-008: Given identical view and query role selectors, When editing a view, Then controls stay within View Builder
CF-POM-009: Given hidden upload input and export link, When transferring synthetic files, Then filenames and download bytes match
CF-POM-014: Given virtual AntD options, When selecting a currency, Then the associated visible item receives the click
CF-POM-015: Given a switch already enabled, When setting it enabled twice, Then no toggle occurs
CF-POM-010: Given a disabled footer Close, When closing a comment dialog, Then the header control closes its own dialog
CF-POM-011: Given duplicate generated SSI fields, When editing a Vostro section, Then the Nostro input remains unchanged
CF-POM-012: Given indexed splitting rows, When editing one child amount, Then adjacent amounts remain unchanged
CF-POM-013: Given the splitting affirmation submit literal, When submitting, Then the source-defined button receives the click
CF-POM-016: Given a portalled export dialog, When choosing XLSX, Then its filename and format controls hold the selected values
CF-PAGE-001: Given separate blotter tiles, When using page controls, Then only the selected tile changes
CF-PAGE-002: Given conditional search fields, When switching each variant, Then only the active field accepts input
CF-PAGE-003: Given conditional amount inputs, When choosing each operator, Then the matching amount fields hold the values
CF-PAGE-004: Given repeated quick-filter options, When choosing a filter, Then its associated popup receives the selection
CF-PAGE-005: Given load-size settings, When selecting a new size, Then the footer uses that size and skips a repeated selection
CF-PAGE-006: Given preset counters and a portalled notification, When activating them, Then their exact identities select the intended controls
